name: Jindal Capital Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994. Jindal Capital Limited is engaged in fund based activities and advisory services.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered as a Non-Banking Financial Company. It invests in shares, both quoted and unquoted, and Mutual funds. Investments in capital market are done through Portfolio Managers and on its own.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -20.6% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.26% over last 3 years.
